summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist persistence audit  ### What I found before proposing anything (read-only, no changes made)  I traced the full path and it's cleaner than the ticket assumes:  - **`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`** — has its own inline auth middleware (separate from the shared `requireAuth` in `db/auth.ts`) that reads the `arca_session` cookie, calls `getSession(token)`, and injects `X-User-Id`. Every single route (list/create/get/update/delete/add-item/remove-item) filters by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)` before touching a row. No anonymous/guest fallback exists anywhere i
